description: On the bed in front of you are three small Tolkien paperback books and an open cardboard slipcase standing on the right. The right hand first reaches in from the right to grasp the blue book, lifts it, and slides it into the open slipcase, then picks up the red book and inserts it beside the blue one; finally, the right hand grabs the green book and brings it toward the remaining empty space in the slipcase, aligning it to slide in.
